EXECUTIVE ORDER
Executive Order 
No. 658: Establishing Requirements for Responsible Data Center Development
DATE:	
09/08/2026

ISSUER:	
Maura Healey

MASS REGISTER:	
No. 1583

WHEREAS, demand for data storage, processing capabilities, and computational tasks is increasing;

WHEREAS, data centers are energy- and resource-intensive facilities;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, Maura T. Healey, Governor of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, by virtue of the authority vested in me by the Constitution, Part 2, c. 2, § I, Art. I, do hereby order as follows:

SECTION 1.

The Department of Public Utilities shall open a proceeding on data center rates.

SECTION 2.

Data centers shall report their water use annually.

Each report shall be public.

SECTION 15.

This Executive Order shall be effective upon the date signed.  

THIS IS PART OF: Massachusetts Executive Orders 600-699 
No. 657: Investing in Primary Care in Massachusetts
Help Us Improve Mass.gov
